title: Determine allowed project actions
responsibility: Determines which actions the shown project allows, using reported capabilities and requiring an available operation before enabling comments.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop connection. Its optional capabilities reader is used when the snapshot does not state capabilities, and its addComment operation must exist before comments can be enabled.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.snapshot
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot, including optional capabilities and project identity. Capabilities stated in the snapshot take precedence over a separate read.

outputs.name: closedCapabilities
outputs.description: The default read-only capabilities: comments, agents, planning and approval all disabled, with local as the source.

outputs.name: projectCapabilities
outputs.description: A promise for the available actions and their source, with an optional reason. Uses snapshot capabilities first, otherwise asks the connection for this project. If that read fails, disables all actions and explains that the project did not report its permissions. For an older connection without a capabilities reader, agents, planning and approval stay enabled and comments stay disabled. Reported comments are enabled only when addComment is a function.
